<?php
spl_autoload_register(function ($class) {
    if (strpos($class, 'WaaSHost\\') === 0) {
        $file = dirname(__DIR__) . '/src/' . str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, 9)) . '.php';
        if (is_file($file)) {
            require $file;
        }
    }
});

<?php
// Test only: a FluentCart customer portal page and four subscriptions with websites, for the admin user.
add_action('init', function () {
    if (get_option('waas_portal_seeded') || !class_exists('\FluentCart\App\Models\Customer')) {
        return;
    }
    update_option('waas_portal_seeded', 1);
    $GLOBALS['waas_seeded_now'] = true;
    $page = wp_insert_post(['post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Account', 'post_name' => 'account', 'post_content' => '[fluent_cart_customer_profile]']);
    $settings = get_option('fluent_cart_store_settings', []);
    $settings['customer_profile_page_id'] = $page;
    $settings['customer_profile_page_slug'] = 'account';
    update_option('fluent_cart_store_settings', $settings, true);
    $user = get_user_by('id', 1);
    wp_update_user(['ID' => 1, 'first_name' => 'Jordan', 'last_name' => 'Lee', 'display_name' => 'Jordan Lee']);
    $customer = \FluentCart\App\Models\Customer::create(['user_id' => 1, 'email' => $user->user_email, 'first_name' => 'Jordan', 'last_name' => 'Lee', 'status' => 'active']);
    $sites = [
        ['Website Small', ['waas_tenant_external_id' => 'ext-1', 'waas_domain_name' => 'juniperstreetbakery.anypress.site', 'waas_tenant_state' => 'Ready']],
        ['Store Small', ['waas_tenant_external_id' => 'ext-2', 'waas_base_domain_name' => 'fernandclay.anypress.site', 'waas_tenant_state' => 'Provisioning']],
        ['Bookings Small', ['waas_tenant_state' => 'Needs New Name']],
        ['Website Medium', ['waas_tenant_external_id' => 'ext-4', 'waas_domain_name' => 'oldsite.anypress.site', 'waas_tenant_state' => 'Deleted']],
    ];
    foreach ($sites as [$name, $meta]) {
        $sub = \FluentCart\App\Models\Subscription::create([
            'customer_id' => $customer->id, 'parent_order_id' => 0, 'product_id' => 0, 'variation_id' => 0, 'item_name' => $name,
            'currency' => 'USD', 'billing_interval' => 'monthly', 'recurring_amount' => 1200, 'recurring_total' => 1200,
            'status' => 'active', 'next_billing_date' => gmdate('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + 20 * 86400),
        ]);
        foreach ($meta as $k => $v) {
            $sub->updateMeta($k, $v);
        }
    }
}, 99);
// Show the domain records as a shop with DNS settings would.
add_filter('pre_option_waas_dns_a_records', fn () => '203.0.113.10');
add_filter('pre_option_waas_dns_cname_target', fn () => 'stores.anypress.site');
add_action('wp_loaded', function () {
    if (empty($GLOBALS['waas_seeded_now']) && get_option('waas_portal_seeded') && !get_option('waas_portal_flushed')) {
        update_option('waas_portal_flushed', 1);
        flush_rewrite_rules(false);
    }
}, 99);
